about: The behaviour of phase 1, step 1.5: combo scaling, style and the meter, recorded by tests/golden/record.mjs; tests/golden-test.mjs replays the cases in tests/golden/cases.mjs and compares. Each sample is { tick, digest, hash, fp }: the running digest of every tick so far, hashState (for information only), and the fingerprint, whose rows LAYOUT names.
